{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify internal test orders: revenue = 999999.99
test_orders = data[data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of internal test orders: {len(test_orders)}")
print(f"Test order revenue values: {test_orders['revenue_clean'].tolist()}")

# Filter to completed orders and exclude test orders
completed_orders = data[(data['status'] == 'completed') & (data['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]
print(f"Number of completed orders after excluding test orders: {len(completed_orders)}")

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].sum()
print(f"Total revenue from completed orders (excluding test orders): {total_revenue}")

# Return the value for the answer
total_revenue"}
